description: WRITE: create a job (work order) for a customer. `customer_id` is the customer's internal `id` (from kickserv_get_customer), not the customer number; `job_type_id` is the job category. Set `estimate` to create it as an estimate. Kickserv: POST /{account}/jobs.xml.

description.description: Job description / work to be done.

employee_ids.description: Employee `id`s (from kickserv_list_employees) to assign. Replaces the current assignment.

ends_at.description: When the job ends. A date/time string Kickserv can parse, e.g. `2026-10-02 09:30` or `10/2/2026 09:30am`.

estimate.description: True to create the job as an estimate.

scheduled_on.description: When the job is scheduled. A date/time string Kickserv can parse, e.g. `2026-10-02 09:30` or `10/2/2026 09:30am`.

name: kickserv_create_job
title: Create a job
